title: Letter 78
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Letters of St. Jerome > Letter 78

notes.text: A treatise on the Forty-two Mansions or Halting-places of the Israelites, originally intended for Fabiola but not completed until after her death. Sent to Oceanus along with the preceding letter. These Mansions are made an emblem of the Christian's pilgrimage, the true Hebrew hastening to pass from earth to heaven.
